summary: DLR(2016)用相邻州界断点给出最强的monopsony/摩擦指纹:最低工资显著压低employment flows(分离与雇佣双降,尤其低tenure工人)却不压低stocks,非就业持续时间不变,与内生分离的搜寻模型一致。离职下降降低了雇主的招聘/空缺成本,正是'涨薪却不减员'的微观机理。

evidence.title: DLR:流量降而存量不降
evidence.quote: We find that minimum wages have a sizable negative effect on employment flows but not on stocks. Separations and accessions fall among affected workers, especially those with low tenure.

evidence.title: DLR:搜寻模型解释
evidence.quote: This evidence is consistent with search models with endogenous separations.

open_questions: turnover下降带来的成本节省能覆盖多大比例的加薪?
